description: The even and odd natural numbers are infinite sets homogeneous in colour 0 for the parity pair colouring; no three-element set is homogeneous in colour 1.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PartitionRelations.parityColoring_spec :
  ({a | a % 2 = 0}.Infinite ∧
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.IsHomogeneousIn Lemmatheca.Entry.PartitionRelations.parityColoring
        {a | a % 2 = 0} 0) ∧
    ({a | a % 2 = 1}.Infinite ∧
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.IsHomogeneousIn Lemmatheca.Entry.PartitionRelations.parityColoring
          {a | a % 2 = 1} 0) ∧
      ∀ (H : Finset ℕ),
        H.card = 3 →
          ¬Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.IsHomogeneousIn Lemmatheca.Entry.PartitionRelations.parityColoring
              (↑H) 1
